rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose term for the courtroom, the judges sitting, or a court session.

example.english: This case will be heard in court tomorrow.
example.traditional: 呢單案聽日會喺法庭開審。
example.jyutping: ni1 daan1 on3 ting1 jat6 wui5 hai2 faat3 ting4 hoi1 sam2

rows.note: Use this for a court as a legal institution or court system rather than the physical courtroom.

example.english: These kinds of cases have to be handled by the court.
example.traditional: 呢類案件要交畀法院處理。
example.jyutping: ni1 leoi6 on3 gin6 jiu3 gaau1 bei2 faat3 jyun2 cyu2 lei5

rows.note: Use this for a sports court or playing area.

example.english: We go to the court to play basketball after school.
example.traditional: 放學後我哋去球場打籃球。
example.jyutping: fong3 hok6 hau6 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 kau4 coeng4 daa2 laam4 kau4

rows.note: Use this for an open courtyard or enclosed central space in or between buildings, not a dead-end street.

example.english: There is an open court in the middle of this tenement building.
example.traditional: 呢間唐樓中間有個天井。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 tong4 lau4 zung1 gaan1 jau5 go3 tin1 zeng2
